drhp.business: Sacheerome, incorporated in 1992, is a B2B company in the fragrance and flavours industry. Its original fragrance business makes custom compounds for personal care, hair care, home care, fine fragrances and cosmetics, and it added flavours in 2014 for beverages, bakery, confectionery, dairy and health and nutrition products. It works on a brief-to-formulation model directly with corporate FMCG and D2C brands, building each fragrance or flavour to the customer's brief. It has about 160 employees, 54 of them in R&D, including flavourists and perfumers. Production is in New Delhi, with an installed capacity of 7.6 lakh kg a year, and a new plant is being built in Gautam Buddha Nagar (YEIDA), Uttar Pradesh.
